name: European Quantum Industry Consortium (QuIC)
description: QuIC is a pan-European not-for-profit association founded in 2021 to support the growth of the commercial quantum technology sector. With over 160 members including large enterprises, SMEs, investors, and startups, it operates working groups on use cases, strategic roadmaps, standards, intellectual property, and education across the European quantum ecosystem.

news.title: ICQIA Urges Prioritization of Quantum Technologies During Canada's G7 Presidency
news.excerpt: On October 11, 2024, the International Council of Quantum Industry Associations (ICQIA), submitted a letter to Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, advocating for the prioritization of quantum technologies during Canada's G7 Presidency in 2025.
